dossiers.catalyst_stack: On 2026-09-02 Judge Brinkema refused a DOJ AdX divestiture and imposed behavioral remedies, stripping the worst-case breakup overhang from the ads cash engine. Q1/Q2 2026 beats ($109.9B then $119.8B, Cloud +82% in Q2) and capex lifts to $195–205B, reinforced by the 2026-09-09 €13B Finland/nuclear build, SpaceX GPU offtake, and the Blackstone TPU-cloud JV, define an aggressive AI capacity cycle. That cycle was partly funded by the ~$90B June 4 equity raise (including Berkshire), which is dilutive, while the EU Court on 2026-07-02 locked in the €4.125B Android fine and Brussels still wants Android AI features and search data opened to rivals. Mid/late-September PT hikes to $400–$485 support the growth tape, but FCF absorption from capex and leftover EU/US remedies remain the swing factors versus the Cloud/AI run-rate.
dossiers.key_assumption: AI/Cloud demand continues to absorb $195–205B of 2026 capex plus GPU/TPU offtake at returns that offset the June equity dilution and leftover antitrust constraints, with U.S. ad-tech relief staying behavioral rather than structural.

dossiers.catalyst_stack: On July 22, 2026 Alphabet beat Q2 revenue at $119.8B as Cloud jumped 82% to $24.8B, after a Q1 beat on April 29, while 2026 capex was raised to $195–$205B and a June 4 ~$80–85B equity raise (including Berkshire) funded the AI build. Product launches stacked through the year: Gemini Intelligence on Android (May 12), Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O (May 20), and Gemini 4 Argon (September 30), with reports on October 6 that a $1B+ Constellation nuclear PPA is near. Legal outcomes split: on September 2 a U.S. judge rejected a DOJ ad-tech breakup, and on September 30 Chegg/Penske AI Overviews claims were dismissed, but the same day a New York judge left billions in publisher ad-tech damages in play. Offsetting that, the European Commission fined Alphabet €890M on July 23 for DMA breaches, while Tigress, Evercore, Rosenblatt, and Piper lifted targets into the $400–$485 range in August–September.
dossiers.key_assumption: Cloud/AI demand absorbs $195–205B 2026 capex without a lasting FCF/multiple break, and U.S. search/ad-tech remedies stay behavioral rather than a breakup or forced data-sharing that hits Search defaults.
